findings.summary: A presigned S3 PUT URL cannot enforce an object size limit. Only a presigned POST policy can.
findings.evidence: The URL is short-lived and scoped to one key, method and size.
findings.fix: Say the URL is scoped to one key and method and expires. For size limits, use a presigned POST with a content-length-range condition, or validate the size after upload.

findings.summary: CORS is described as protecting the same-origin policy. It relaxes the same-origin policy in a controlled way.
